steps.title: Equilibrate GFP-Trap Agarose Beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 10 µL of GFP-Trap agarose beads with water and twice with EBB.

steps.title: Bind ATG9A Vesicles to Beads
steps.instruction: Incubate freshly purified ATG9A vesicles (from 5x 15-cm plates) or MOCK controls (from wild-type HAP1 cells) with the equilibrated beads at 4 °C for 05:00:00 with gentle rotation.

substeps.instruction: Optionally store overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Vesicle-Beads
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 200 µL SEC150 and resuspend in 5 µL – 10 µL SEC150.

steps.title: Prepare PL-Coated Beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 10 µL GFP-Trap beads with water and twice with SEC150, then incubate 500 µL of PLs with beads at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads with SEC150 after binding before downstream applications

steps.title: Perform Protein Binding Assay
steps.instruction: Set up the reaction in wells using prey proteins and bead suspensions.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL prey protein (0.1 micromolar (µM) mCherry-PI3KC3-C1 or ATG2A-mCherry) into each well
Add 1 µL of bead suspension (coated with ATG9A vesicles or MOCK control) per well
Incubate 00:30:00 at Room temperature prior to imaging

steps.title: PI3KC3-C1 Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Incubate vesicle/PL-coated GFP-Trap beads with PI3KC3-C1 and FYVE probes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate beads with 0.03 micromolar (µM) PI3KC3-C1 for 00:30:00
Add 0.03 micromolar (µM) mCherry-2xFYVE and incubate 00:10:00
Add cofactors to initiate PI(3)P production

steps.title: Prepare ATG9A PLs with ATG2A
steps.instruction: Incubate 125 µL ATG9A PLs with 10 micromolar (µM) ATG2A and 6.25 µL donor liposomes (0.5 mg/mL) overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bind and Wash ATG2A-PL Complexes
steps.instruction: Bind the complexes to 5 µL GFP-Trap beads for 05:00:00 and perform a sequential wash.

substeps.instruction: Wash once with SEC150
Wash once with SEC250 (25 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 250 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT)
Wash once with SEC350 (25 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 350 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT)
Wash twice with SEC150
Resuspend in 3 µL SEC150

steps.title: Perform PI3KC3-C1 Activity Assay on ATG2A-PLs
steps.instruction: Add PI3KC3-C1, cofactors, and mCherry-2xFYVE as described in the PI3KC3-C1 activity assay step.

steps.title: Lipidatable Protein Assay
steps.instruction: Set up the lipidatable protein reaction using ATG9A vesicle-coated beads.

substeps.instruction: Use 0.5 µL GFP-Trap beads coated with ATG9A vesicles per 20 µL reaction
Add 250 nanomolar (nM) each of: mCherry-GABARAPΔL117 (lipidatable), ATG7 (E1), ATG3 (E2), and ATG5-ATG12-ATG16L1 (E3)
Add 2 millimolar (mM) ATP and 1 millimolar (mM) MgCl₂
Incubate for 02:30:00 at 30 °C
Wash beads once with SEC150

steps.title: Prepare GST-Bait Beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate 5 µL Glutathione Sepharose beads with water and SEC150, then incubate with 5 micromolar (µM) GST-tagged bait in SEC150 for 01:00:00 at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads 3x with SEC150
Resuspend in 5 µL SEC150

steps.title: Bind ATG2A to GST-Bait Beads
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of 0.5 micromolar (µM) ATG2A-mCherry or ATG2A-LIR-mCherry into wells and add 1 µL beads per well.

steps.title: Image Samples
steps.instruction: Image all samples using a Zeiss LSM 700 confocal microscope equipped with a Plan Apochromat 20×/0.8 WD 0.55 mm objective.
